decisions.reason: As a niche extension of the firm's established spraying business in a growing industry, it is likely kept because its strategic fit is strong and the firm's engineering slack reduces pressure to exit after only one year.
This product is close to the core offer and was given its own webpage, so management would likely see early signals as satisfactory enough to continue rather than reallocate resources.
A multi-model transfer pump line that builds directly on existing capabilities is highly consistent with the firm's broad portfolio strategy, making withdrawal within a year unlikely.

Although somewhat more specialized and possibly more uncertain than the core pumping products, it still fits the firm's process and monitoring direction, so with available organizational slack it is more likely retained than dropped.
